work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CCCXLIV grants in perpetuity to the confraternity of Our Lady of Mercy in the parish church of S. Sebastián in Madrid that Mass be celebrated on feast days an hour before dawn and after noon; intitulation, ad perpetuam formula, narrative, grant, decernentes and non obstantibus clauses and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF65953–65953; the source dating clause at LF66018–66021 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima tertia ianuarii mille- simo octingentesimo quadragesimo sexto, pon- tificatus Nostri anno decimo quinto. Isolated OCR marks fused into body lines remain literal and are not removed or corrected: LF65986 “.”. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
